title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The performance of an LLM agent depends on both its model and its harness, the code that mediates its interaction with tools and environments. Can LLM researchers drive this co-evolution as a recursive improvement process, deciding round after round which component to change when each change alters the value of the other? Existing benchmarks evaluate post-training or data research with the harness out of scope, or harness optimization with the model fixed, leaving this joint decision unmeasured. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs as researchers co-evolving the model and harness of a target agent across five agentic domains. Researchers start from a common base model and initial harness, train and revise within a 24-hour budget, and submit a model-harness pair that is scored on separate test tasks. translated_title: CoEvoBench：大语言模型能否驱动智能体系统的递归协同进化？
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的性能同时取决于其模型和其框架，即调停其与工具和环境交互的代码。LLM研究者能否将这种协同进化作为一个递归改进过程来推动——在一轮又一轮中决定该修改哪个组件，而每一次修改都会改变另一个组件的价值？现有基准要么在框架不在评估范围内的前提下评估训练后优化或数据研究，要么在模型固定的前提下进行框架优化，这使得这一联合决策从未被衡量过。我们提出CoEvoBench，这是一个将LLM作为研究者进行评估的基准，这些研究者在五个智能体领域中协同进化目标智能体的模型与框架。研究者从共同的基础模型和初始框架出发，在24小时预算内进行训练和修改，并提交一个模型-框架组合，该组合将在独立的测试任务上进行评分。在五个前沿研究者中，表现最强者弥合了与一个指令微调参考（系统）之间超过五分之四的差距。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CoEvoBench——首个同时评估LLM作为研究者联合协同进化智能体的模型与框架（harness）的基准，在24小时预算和五个智能体领域中衡量这一此前未被测量的递归联合决策能力。
en_tdlr: CoEvoBench is the first benchmark that evaluates LLMs as researchers jointly co-evolving both the model and harness of an agentic system, measuring this previously unmeasured recursive joint decision-making across five agentic domains under a 24-hour budget.
